name: strength-blocks-per-block-build
description: Sequential blocks of the SAME lift where EACH block carries its own build, saved as per-occurrence loggedWeights (the real 2026-07-30 shape). Block A climbed 40->50 over its four doubles; block B carried on 50->65 over its four singles. Two things must hold. (1) Each row shows ITS OWN build, exactly as a lone lift would — never the merged breakdown progression, which holds only [40,50] and would print block A's range on both rows. (2) TOP SET is 65: the peak lives ONLY on block B's occurrence — the breakdown progression stops at 50 and the completed sets stop at 50, so any top-set reading that skips the occurrences reports 50 and contradicts the row printed right above it.
